text:
teri: Quick flag from QA — compact dashboard mode looks tight after recent spacing tweak. image: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/compact-dashboard-2001.png
ash: which token changed? I only touched the compact column gap last sprint.
ash: I reduced --gap-compact from 10px -> 6px to fit extra column on medium screens.
mikko: 6px is pushing our touch guidance. action icons are <44px on phones.
yara: Accessibility: focus ring overlaps divider in keyboard nav. visual noise for high-contrast users.
teri: Options: revert gap, add invisible hit padding, or shave header padding. preferences?
ash: Invisible padding via ::before works but breaks in cards with overflow. not ideal.
axel: I vote revert to 8px and reduce card body vertical padding by 2px. keeps density and preserves hit targets.
yara: Also add outline-offset: 2px on .card-row:focus so focus never clips.
teri: Agreed. small token delta is easier to audit. Also quick toast note: success toasts linger 4.5s — folks doing rapid saves see backlog. propose success 2.5s, errors remain sticky.
ash: fine by me. i'll prepare a tiny hotfix: --gap-compact 6px -> 8px, --card-body-pt 12px -> 10px, add outline-offset, toast timing change, and update tokens doc.
mikko: assign me for visual QA. designbot: please remind to update tokens.md and components/a11y.md.
teri: Plan: patch today, visual diffs tomorrow. thanks team :raised_hands:
